nom: ANUA KPop Demon Hunters Ceramide Barrier Collagen Mask

avis.texte: I loved the results! Had to be a bit gentle putting it on, but otherwise I slept good with it on! (One of my masks were not cut right so I couldn't use it once tho)

avis.titre: The best version of these masks i've tried so far
avis.texte: ive tried now 3 of these mask from all different brands this one is honestly my favorite sometimes I sleep with them on sometimes I don't when I used this one I didn't and I still got a really pretty glow to the skin other masks slide around way more than this one it didn't break me out and the cut out sizes and just face fitting is perfect on me i hope they keep it the same for all their masks
You have to be very gentle when using this product otherwise it can rip easily. I slept with this on and my skin felt so amazing!!
these masks make my skin feel so moisturized and hydrated! definitely see a difference from before and after using it.

I've tried a few collagen overnight masks, and so far, this is the best. I did not try to sleep in it, but I left it on for about three hours. I was super impressed by how smooth ans plump it left my skin, especially my forehead. Great results for the price.
As soon as i put it on it ripped three times then it would not stick to my face couldn't even see a change before and after.

I got the 4 pack online and just tried it. I loved it because of the cooling quality. I did my regular face routine with my cleanser, then I followed up with my Anua toner. Once I did those steps, I actually put the mask on. The coverage was good. The mask felt nice and cool on my face. The packaging recommend leaving it on for 1-2 hours, but I only did 20 minutes. Left my face feeling nice. It was a great break up of my normal routine and it felt relaxing.

So I bought this mask yesterday and tried it out last night. I loved the fit of the mask! it covered well and didnt slip at all. Sadly the next day I didnt see much improvement and my skin was really red and a bit sticky not soft like most masks make my skin feel the next day. it's cute and fit well but I wouldnt but it again.
